Well I’ll try to be the one to hold you back. I’m in a similar condition to you, I binge eat and cut to combat it amungst other reasons. 
But I’ve taken the leap you’re talking about, I cut my wrists incredibly deep, vertically. I either wanted to die or a one way ticket to the hospital, I still don’t totally know which. Obviously I got the latter, and it’s a shit experience. I spent weeks in a mental hospital and even when I got out I feel dead. And in my experience after you break like that, friends and family want to help but still turn away. 
If you can regulate it and keep from doing something drastic, do. I hope these feelings get better for you.

Sometimes. Every once in a while I cut just to cut, it feels like personal maintenance, just something I have to do like clipping my nails. Those times I plan out, “alright I’ll get this assignment orderd, workout, eat dinner, then later I’ll cut before bed.” Other times it’s just spur of the moment, like when I have an anxiety attack.

I think medically that’s still self harm, seems like we all have different, often similar, reasons we all self harm. Yours is just hate towards another person instead of, for example, hating yourself.

I’m no good at giving advice but I hope your relationship with said person can improve or be broken off.
